C_minus_A.attribution_boundary: LoRA continuation on the same frozen bridge; selected validation checkpoints.
C_minus_A.delta_units: raw metric difference; multiply by100 for percentage points; FPR increase is worse

D_minus_C.attribution_boundary: Joint bridge+LoRA versus LoRA-only; different trainables and bridge learning rate.
D_minus_C.delta_units: raw metric difference; multiply by100 for percentage points; FPR increase is worse

D_minus_A.attribution_boundary: Joint bridge+LoRA continuation versus its original bridge.
D_minus_A.delta_units: raw metric difference; multiply by100 for percentage points; FPR increase is worse

R_minus_Cpair.attribution_boundary: Matched paired data sequence/microbatch/optimizer; ranking objective contrast.
R_minus_Cpair.delta_units: raw metric difference; multiply by100 for percentage points; FPR increase is worse

Cpair_minus_C.attribution_boundary: Compound category-paired sampling and microbatch change; not ranking effect.

Cstructured_minus_C.attribution_boundary: Same C weights; structured instructions and generation budget differ.
Cstructured_minus_C.delta_units: raw metric difference; multiply by100 for percentage points; FPR increase is worse

S_minus_Cstructured.attribution_boundary: Structured supervised continuation; same schema/prompt/budget; adds masks and tokens.
S_minus_Cstructured.delta_units: raw metric difference; multiply by100 for percentage points; FPR increase is worse

limitations: Saved raw predictions are the source of metrics; no incomplete result enters a mean.
Partial means use only listed seeds and are not complete three-seed results.
Parameters/cost separate source training from newly trained condition parameters; A/Cstructured have zero new training.
Basic and structured instructions/max output tokens differ; cross-schema differences are compound.
No external selection, private unseen-data guarantee, or significance claim.
